hack.root_cause: Storage Layout Collision → Unauthorized Proxy Upgrade / Ownership Takeover
hack.description: Pike Finance was exploited twice in four days — the second time using the same root vulnerability introduced by the emergency patch deployed to fix the first: a storage layout collision that left proxy contracts re-initializable and ownership stealable.
